build.buildCommand: npm install --omit=dev && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium && apt-get update && apt-get install -y xvfb xauth

deploy.startCommand: npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma-roster/schema.prisma && if command -v xvfb-run >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v xauth >/dev/null 2>&1; then xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1600x1000x24' node src/index.js; else node src/index.js; fi
